verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack indicates 1Password's client apps are open source or available for community code review; all citations describe closed commercial SDKs, CLI, Connect servers, and browser extension features without any open-source licensing or public repository claims for the core vault/client apps themselves. missing for 10: any statement of open-source licensing for 1Password clients, a public source repository for the desktop/mobile/browser apps, or third-party audit citing open code review.
